text:
maeve: Noticed a sudden spike in TLS handshake resets from eu-proxy -> apac-ingress around 11:12UTC. Correlated with cert-rotator job at 11:10. Any ideas? :thinking_face:

sanjay: saw that too, logs show a lot of cache-evict events and repeated re-fetch to KMS for key rewraps. Possibly rotator triggered full fanout instead of rolling update. :eyes:

maeve: rotator logs: `rotator: started batch rotate for service apac-ingress, mode=parallel` — we usually run sequential. Why did it pick parallel?

rotator-bot: scheduled job 2026-04-08T11:10Z executed. policy=default-parallel ; triggered by PR 4921. (reacted with :white_check_mark:)

olivia: PR 4921 changed RBAC for rotator service-account to include iam:ListKeys but removed kms:Decrypt in staging by mistake. Could be fallback causing repeated unwrap attempts. I'm looking.

drew: if rotator loses KMS decrypt, it might spawn retries and evict caches because certs not successfully re-provisioned. That explains thundering eviction + handshake resets.

maeve: can someone grep audit logs for KMS Deny events around that time? Also we need to check edge-proxy SNI mapping — maybe old certs still served for some hosts causing mismatch.

sanjay: grep snippet: ```grep 'KMS' /var/log/audit/*.log | egrep 'Decrypt|Deny' | sed -n '1800,1845p'``` — found 84 Deny entries from rotator-SA at 11:10:25 -> 11:11:02

olivia: confirmed: RBAC diff in PR removed `kms:Decrypt` from rotator-SA in eu region role binding. The CI check did not catch it because policy lint targets global role, not regional overrides.

maeve: action items: 1) re-add kms:Decrypt to role binding in eu (hotfix), 2) run a constrained rotator replay (sequential), 3) correlate handshake resets -> issue incident ticket, 4) add audit alert for repeated KMS denies causing cache thrash

drew: +1. I'll push hotfix now and coordinate oncall rollback page. Hotfix patch: `kubectl apply -f rotator-eu-fix.yaml`

rotator-bot: deploy started for rotator-eu-fix, build 4921-hotfix, CI passed

olivia: also proposed to add audit log correlation id to rotator calls: include `X-Request-ID` from cert-store and ensure KMS unwrap logs surface that id — makes postmortem easier.

maeve: good. Also let's add a probe that detects >50 cache-evict/sec for any edge service in 1m window and page eng-sre.

sanjay: for mitigations we should use a short-term circuit breaker: if rotator sees >5 Deny in 30s, back off and alert instead of fanout. I'll draft config.

drew: hotfix applied, rotator restarted at 11:18UTC — early metrics show evictions dropping. I'll keep watching for 30m.

maeve: thanks. Postmortem owners: olivia (RBAC), sanjay (audit alerts), drew (rotator changes). We'll schedule follow-up + changelog. :thumbsup:
